uncertainties.note: Untagged allies/bystanders reacting to and fighting Meio Plato. No speaker identity or gender assigned to any of these lines; 'he'/'that one' refers back to Meio Plato, already named by the preceding batch, not an inferred subject.

Source phrase (romaji: jitsu no imouto, 'his own/real sister') is not named in the source. character_names_021.json's Meio Plato entry names a sister ('Linda') in his role description, but since the dialogue itself never names her, no name was inserted (do not supply what the source omits).

These seven rows read as alternate branch/route outcomes for the Meio Plato encounter (a 'ran out of time' line at 2658, a fresh-enemy-sighted branch at 2659-2660, a lone declaration at 2661, Meio's own remark at 2662, a plea-to-not-fight branch at 2663-2664) resolved by an explicit player choice at 2665 ('Which will you choose?'). Translated each line literally without merging them into one storyline or guessing which branch is 'the' canon outcome; flagging for whoever maps scene branches.

Scene break: rows 2666-2702 (still resource 6080, later text-id range 501-653) leave the timed combat lines behind for an untimed <on()> post-mission conference (no <ab>/<off>), matching the pattern already reported for rows 2375-2437 in batch_02375. It covers Char Aznable's Neo Zeon declaration, the New Federation and Meio Plato threads, and the decision to split forces between 'this Earth' and the other world to search for Berkt and watch Shin Dragon.

Source title (romaji: shirei, 'the commander') kept as a generic title rather than re-inserting the name Misumaru given two rows earlier at 2668; the referent is inferable from context but not repeated by the source itself.

Source phrase (romaji: rei no mujinki, 'that [previously mentioned] drone') has no clear antecedent within this slice's context window; kept vague as 'that drone' rather than guessing which unit is meant.

Source says bare 'Boueisensou' (Defensive War) without the 'Daiichiji' (First) prefix that produced the locked 'First Defensive War' at row 1111/opening_history_terms.json. Rendered here as plain 'Defensive War' by analogy with the book(9) Federation/Earth Federation adaptation pattern (book id kept the same, English adapts to the literal source wording). Flagged for orchestrator confirmation; see glossary proposal.
